appearance.build: Lean, trauma-shaped, predator-like posture; honed by survival and internal heat; posture goes statue-still when containing rage
appearance.hair: Reddish-brown, short and tousled; greys/ashens under duress; Kitsune form: blood-red with black undertones
appearance.facial_hair: Trimmed beard and mustache — maintained, not decorative
appearance.eyes: Formerly brown; now luminous white-blue halo irises (crystal-veil integration); amethyst glow on deep thread dives; silver-grey flow during dissociative collapse; void-white burn when fully unleashed; currently a brown-red due to loss of powers (occasionally flashes brighter during Spark activation)
appearance.skin: Pale with faint crystalline traceries; veins glow under surge; luster dulled during emotional voiding; wraith form: void-dark skin with soot-serpent tails; currently tan due to loss of powers
appearance.scent: Neutral-clean when calm; slight ozone/metal when Spark or heatworking is active; faint warm-lantern/woodsmoke note when Hearthbound is sustaining around him
appearance.posture: Adaptive — upright/methodical in command, slouched when reflective, folds inward when collapsing; goes eerily still when switching from banter to lethal intent

relationship.Kestrel: Best friend / trusted anchor; Chapter 13 deepened the bond through shared guardianship of Pip, disclosure of Nyx, physical affection, and immediate repair when he believed he had hurt her.
relationship.Irix: Best friend / chosen family; Chapter 13 deepened the bond through shared protection of Pip, private hospitality in Irix's suite, disclosure of Nyx, and openly affectionate goodbyes.
relationship.Mirell: Acquaintance (Irix’s new friend; treated as ally-by-proxy)

Pip.notes: Pip calls him Daa or Fok Daa. Jayson accepted full responsibility for her care, registered her as his dependent, protects her personhood, built her a drawer-den, manages her food and safety, and openly told her he loves her.

Nyx.notes: Jayson met Nyx in Elandria's realm, treated her as a person, invited her to experience student life, helped articulate her merciful nature, and became trusted enough to reveal her identity to Kestrel and Irix with permission.

Elandria.notes: Chapter 13: Jayson confronted her over his displacement and family, demanded concrete action, and received proof through the safe return of four wives. He later entered her realm, met her family, adopted Pip, and used her golden blood in a protective seal during a crisis.

Sari.Status: Friend / rescued Wolfkin student under temporary protection
Sari.notes: Chapter 14: Jayson rescued Sari and Mela from an abduction attempt, exposed the network using Sari's room as a low-visibility host site, gave them Room 13 as temporary refuge, helped register Mela as Sari's dependent child/person, took Sari to meet her family via Guild portal, and rebuilt her immediate wardrobe and supplies.

Mela.notes: Chapter 14: Jayson rescued and healed Mela, helped formalize her status as a person and Sari's dependent child, included her in Room 13 play and routines, bought her a hero cape, and treated her as one of the children without claiming parental status.

chapter1: Awoke alone on Eryndor after being forcibly displaced by celestials, cut off from Tsunejima and separated from his wives
Accepted the primordial gift known as Spark, understanding it as a slow-burning power tied to sacrifice, endurance, and survival rather than immediate strength
Registered with the Harrowfen Adventurers’ Guild despite lacking papers, choosing legitimacy over anonymity
Encountered and identified Listeners in the wild, successfully using sound misdirection to survive without magic or weapons
Rescued two trapped guards from Listeners using improvised tactics and concealed kitsune abilities
Demonstrated restraint and diplomacy by negotiating a winter survival pact between ratkin refugees and a human baker
Established a personal reputation for competence and mercy as news of his actions spread rapidly between towns
Exposed and disrupted a kidnapping operation involving Vaelir civilians, prioritizing lawful resolution through Guild and city authorities
Accepted repeated escort, rescue, and salvage work to build resources while remaining visibly exhausted and emotionally strained
Formed an early partnership with Kestrel Thorne during a ruins investigation, despite a rank imbalance
Encountered Watcher-class entities operating covertly within dungeon-adjacent infrastructure and withdrew rather than escalate
Demonstrated adaptive combat and stealth tactics during a quarry operation involving Listeners, prioritizing extraction over extermination
Revealed his kitsune nature publicly at the Guild unintentionally, creating future social and political risk
Intervened during a warehouse infiltration involving vampires, choosing discretion and de-escalation over capture or violence
Detected and confronted covert surveillance efforts targeting him, recognizing patterns of indexing and threat assessment
Came close to lethal escalation during a confrontation with human observers before being grounded by Kestrel
Chose restraint over vengeance, asserting personal autonomy while refusing to be contained, classified, or owned
Ended the chapter physically safe but emotionally isolated, still receiving no confirmation of his wives’ condition or location
Entered the next phase aware that he is being watched, evaluated, and possibly prepared for containment or exploitation

Freed all slaves, redistributed coin and supplies, ordered testimony to be delivered to the Guild, and destroyed slaver records and infrastructure to prevent recovery

Completed the Grey-moss Depths dungeon under Kestrel’s lead, providing environmental support (water traversal, hazard probing) and rear-guard control
Identified the dungeon’s core mechanic as intent-responsive rather than violence-based
Was separated from the party during the dungeon’s final trial and confronted by a controlling intelligence offering conquest and dominance
Rejected conquest and reward outright, choosing instead the guaranteed safety and release of Kestrel and Irix over personal advancement
Successfully forced the dungeon to comply, resulting in non-hostile completion and safe extraction of the entire party
Returned to Harrowfen and formally completed the dungeon report, advancing his standing and unlocking further Spark development
Supported Irix during her Guild registration, questioning the use of derogatory racial labels and advocating for her right to self-identify
Reinforced Irix’s confidence publicly when bystanders made disparaging remarks, using humor rather than threat to shut down hostility
Became the target of a coordinated night-time extraction attempt by professional assassins seeking Irix, indicating long-term tracking and high-level interest
Detected and countered a multi-vector assassination attempt inside an inn, correctly identifying at least two high-tier operatives and a commanding observer
Blindfolded himself deliberately to reduce cognitive bias and rely on non-visual sensory input during close-quarters combat
Engaged the Observer in near-equal hand-to-hand combat, sustaining impacts but preventing the extraction of Irix
Intentionally maneuvered to recover his katana mid-fight and used it to cut down operatives holding Irix, prioritizing her retrieval over personal safety
Forced the Observer to retreat after throwing his katana with lethal intent, severing the Observer’s ear as a permanent warning rather than pursuing the kill
Delivered an explicit message through action rather than words: that those targeting Irix would be hunted in return
Provided full and honest disclosure to the Guild Marshal after the incident, accepting scrutiny without deflection or minimization
Assumed emotional responsibility for Irix’s exposure following her public registration, acknowledging unintended consequences without withdrawing support
Provided physical and emotional grounding for Irix after delayed shock response, explicitly validating fear as survival rather than weakness
Reframed Irix’s years of flight as competence rather than cowardice, emphasizing that the threat network is now exposed to the Guild
Included Kestrel physically and emotionally during Irix’s breakdown, reinforcing the trio as a bonded unit rather than a loose party
Shifted the group dynamic from temporary alliance to explicit mutual protection, stating clearly that Irix is no longer alone
Ended the chapter having openly declared hostility with unknown higher-order collectors and systems, while solidifying party cohesion and trust
chapter7: Morning after the inn assassination attempt: reported events to the Harrowfen Guild, describing religiously dressed 'verifiers' and an assassin-guild presence operating outside Guild authority
Commissioned custom clothing and shoes for Irix (digigrade legs, tail, wing accommodations) using dungeon leather; purchased cloaks for Irix and Kestrel; tipped heavily
Unlocked Spark upgrades: Hearthbound and Heatwave; discovered Hearth can function as a container and comfort-field (warm/cool control) and as a rain-shield dome while walking

Engineered a leather 'mana filter' that condensed ambient mana into extremely pure white/silver liquid; immediately destroyed the filter pattern afterward to avoid attention
Endured escalating harassment in public spaces and a large inn; used social theater (literalism, flirt-misdirection, ridicule) to defuse hostility without drawing steel
Met University-adjacent scouts/recruiters (in-inn) and insisted any recommendation must include Kestrel and Irix; corrected Irix’s identity as Serathi rather than 'demon'

Outside confrontation in the court park with high-rank adventurers who threatened to drain Irix’s mana/blood and break her legs; Jayson flipped from banter to silent lethal presence, split a leader’s chest plate, forced apology/kneeling, then de-escalated when city officers arrived

Submitted to extreme University intake pipeline: capability tests, endurance/gravity, applied combat, ethical reasoning, mental/soul integrity, sorting, and binding
Triggered public attention during Phase I by cracking a physical monolith and causing abnormal readings on the magical device; remained calm, joked, and avoided escalation
Completed Phase II gravity/endurance circuit under extreme load; collapsed only after completion due to pressure release

In Phase III applied combat, operated tightly with Kestrel; killed efficiently when necessary, and chose to carry an injured stranger rather than abandon him, prioritizing survival + cohesion over pure speed
In Phase IV ethical reasoning, rejected false dilemmas and stated he would prevent loss of life even if it required defying University orders
In Phase V mental/soul integrity, displayed stability and prior exposure to identity destabilization; did not break
Sorting result: designated 'Unattached' rather than placed into a House; flagged as an outlier
Accepted binding/enrollment alongside Kestrel and Irix; observed many candidates refuse and leave
Immediately learned campus pecking order is brutal (beastfolk lowest); formed protective social posture and used nonlethal dominance humor to defuse harassment
Met two Felari catfolk students (Riven and Sael) and informally grouped for safety in numbers on campus routes

chapter10: Post-exam suite downtime: Irix’s wing joints still sore; Jayson maintained care routine (tea + warm compress mindset continued) and used humor to keep the trio light before separation pressure hit

Refused special handling publicly and requested a standard cohort schedule (no accelerations, no independent study favors) to prevent containment-by-bureaucracy
Reassigned from 'Unattached' status into Axiomatic House administration track (formal house placement finalized); Kestrel confirmed Axiomatic, Irix confirmed Veiled, forcing institutional separation

Reinforced his axiom-bounds in class: help increases capability; refuses help that removes agency, trades dignity, hides wrongdoing, or costs more safety than it buys

Workshop/forge build: constructed a micro-scale copper passive condenser (battery-sized circuit architecture) intended to generate pure white mana; kept it framed as delicate 'ornament' for transit and opsec

Role-correction with Kestrel: confronted her stress spiral, reassigned team roles (her patterns, his unpredictability), and created a clean code-word method to end public theatrics without making him look commanded

Dinner-route discipline: chose boring compliance, minimized reaction to bait, and hyper-focused on Irix’s injury markers instead of engaging provocateurs
Irix assaulted: Ashen upper-years grabbed/dragged her shoulder (minor ward abrasion) and used ‘pet/stray’ language to provoke an instability record
Dorm crisis: Irix panicked and weaponized cruelty/racist language against Jayson; he forced the truth-question, de-escalated into procedural action, and accepted steward involvement under quiet-hours
Report strategy: recommended morning filing for accuracy; steward offered timestamp placeholder; Irix chose morning report, no medical tonight

Medical workaround: produced a pure white mana vial via the condenser without tripping wards; left it for Irix to drink after the report to erase pain/marks quickly; promised to stand with her at the desk in the morning
chapter12: Bathhouse escalation: upper-years entered the bathing space with a harder edge; Jayson refused to be intimidated and instead tested the boundary with jokes and controlled boldness

De-escalation by ridicule: performed an elaborate ‘fox-eating spider’ routine using his tails like scuttling legs, dragging himself around aisles and even up a wall, splashing seniors until they were drenched
Exited with social framing: left the seniors inside and publicly summarized the lesson to younger students as ‘how to deal with a stronger enemy’ without direct violence
Rumor seeding: explicitly hoped the campus would spread a haunted-bathhouse rumor (a spider that eats foxes the size of a house)
Aftermath priority: immediately went to locate Kestrel and Irix to ensure they were okay
Common room tension: remained quiet and watchful while the girls talked; emotional distance from Irix’s prior words still visible
Archives grind: spent roughly four hours sketching and planning a device in the archives, filling most of a notebook with Japanese notes and diagrams
Three-way talk (snow/bench): admitted silence was restraint, not indifference; disclosed he had changed plans and was trying to read Irix and listen to Kestrel before acting
Repaired rupture: stated clearly that Irix didn’t ‘break’ anything, but that it hurt because he cares; apologized for not communicating plans sooner
Physical anchoring: pulled Irix into his coat on his lap to shelter her from cold and emotion; a tail wrapped Kestrel’s ankle to anchor her in the moment as well
Personal disclosure: clarified that the four ‘family’ he is seeking are actually wives; explained kitsune heart-strings and his seven-string structure (Heart/Mind/Body/Essence/Soul/Anchor/Instinct)
Comic memory: shared the ‘Seika grenade’ story (throwing Seika while yelling “GRENADE”) as a parallel to joking about an ‘attack Serathi’
Dinner shift: chose to move forward together and get food early; kept Irix tucked under his coat as concealment and warmth
Private flirt-whispers: teased Irix with quiet comments about Kestrel being sexy when serious and “fiesty,” while maintaining a playful tone at the table
chapter13: Confronted Elandria inside his secured university room and made clear that divine explanations would no longer substitute for proof or action.
Demanded that four of his stranded wives be returned safely home.
Received confirmation that Elandria completed the transfer, creating the first meaningful breach in his absolute distrust of her.
Entered Elandria's divine realm and encountered her husband, children, sentient household, silver orchard, ancient stables, and protected mimic nursery.
Met Pip in the nursery and accepted responsibility for her as his daughter and dependent.
Named her Pip after a fruit seed and became Daa through imprinting and choice.
Brought Pip into Eryndor University and fought for recognition of her personhood despite provisional institutional classification.
Created a safe drawer-den beside his bed, managed her food, bathing, warmth, play, and supervision, and incorporated her into daily student life.
Told Pip he loved her and received her direct declaration that she loved Daa lots and lots.
Met Nyx, the literal embodiment of Death, in Elandria's realm and responded with fascination, attraction, humor, and personal recognition rather than fear.
Invited Nyx to experience student life as something different from cosmic duty.
Helped Nyx enter university as Candidate 024 in a cheetah Felari disguise.
Witnessed Nyx receive an unprecedented Triune Scholar placement and Room 14 beside his Room 13 and Kestrel's Room 12.
Supported Pip's immediate recognition of Nyx as pretty cat and pretty Death cat.
Expanded the university friend group through meals, classes, markets, and shared domestic routines.
Intervened when Cael Vorr threw a charged dining spike at Pip, catching it before impact.
Overpowered Cael, forced the truth into the open, and threatened lethal consequences while still allowing Headmistress Aureliane to take institutional control.
Secured elevated protections for Pip after the attack.
Visited Irix's Veiled suite with Kestrel, Pip, and Nyx for a private social evening.
Described the four horses of the apocalypse without initially naming their Riders.
Revealed that he had met Death, then theatrically disclosed that Death's name was Nyx.
Explained that Nyx's identity was not his secret to share and that he waited for her permission and a private opportunity.
Apologized immediately when Kestrel appeared hurt by the delay.
Watched Nyx reveal a fraction of her true form through Irix's window and reacted with unrestrained delight.
Described Nyx's true form as vast, beautiful, and peaceful rather than monstrous.
Declared that Death had become the life of the group and laughed at his own terrible joke.
Ended the evening by hugging Irix, returning to Axiomatic House, hugging Kestrel goodnight, telling Nyx to exist well, placing Pip in her drawer-bed, and telling his daughter that Daa loved her lots.

During a later crisis involving Lysera and Seika, wounded Elandria, used her golden blood to form a ward, sealed a protective connection, and begged his distant loved ones to remain safe until he could find them.
chapter14: Began the chapter in Room 13 with Pip, Kestrel, Irix, and Nyx, continuing domestic life after Pip's attack and Nyx's arrival.
Explained his soul/consciousness model, computers, AI, and FEI's history to the group; Pip learned that she has seven mothers.
Searched for another orchard mimic and discovered Sari and Mela being assaulted and abducted in an old service cloister.
Sealed the room, defeated the attackers, freed and healed Sari and Mela, recorded evidence, and learned the names Adjunct Serik Vaul and Lower Vivarium.
Sent Sari and Mela to Room 13 for protection and called for Aureliane through Kestrel.
Infiltrated the hidden four-level vivarium beneath the western laundry and documented illegal experiments, altered consent, captive Beastfolk, juvenile mimics, and institutional abuse.
Mapped the facility's exits, hidden doors, levels, and hidden areas and stole Vaul's black archive before Aureliane and Marshals seized the site.
Helped medical teams after the rescue and revived a Wolfkin woman in Holding C after her heart stopped, refusing to accept her death as final.
Asked Nyx whether she would ever return someone if he asked; accepted her distinction between not-yet-crossed souls and true resurrection.
Returned to Room 13 and helped formalize Mela as Sari's dependent child/person using Pip's registration template.
Offered Sari and Mela temporary residence in Room 13 and helped recover only essential belongings from Sari's Transcendent dorm.
Discovered Sari's room had been ransacked and used as a low-visibility host site because conspirators assumed a Beastfolk resident would not be believed.
Captured Tomas and Veyr after discovering a hidden cache and remote purge attempt, then delivered both and the cache to Aureliane.
Independently baited Lecturer Halven into revealing knowledge of the cache, subdued him, and turned him over to Aureliane and Marshals once his involvement was confirmed.
Discussed spatial folding with Aureliane and sincerely thanked her for the unseen work and sacrifices involved in protecting the university.
Returned to Room 13 and resumed domestic play with Pip and Mela, including pillow ambushes, raspberries, fruit tricks, and hero games.
Allowed Nyx to reveal her identity as literal Death to Sari after Pip's repeated Pretty Death comments made secrecy increasingly untenable.
Summoned Elandria to meet Sari and Mela, helped establish Room 13's 'no titles, only friends' norm, and relentlessly teased Elandria with Cow Goddess / Goddess of Livestock.
Planned and executed a next-day Guild portal trip with Sari, Pip, and Mela to visit Sari's family before rumors of the vivarium could reach them.
Met Rhuva, Dhorrek, and Keshran; joked about being Sari's new son-in-law, ate several plates of Rhuva's cooking, and promised to do his best to keep Sari safe.
Returned to Valenhold and paid for replacement clothing for Sari, gifts for Kestrel and Irix, clothing for Nyx and Elandria, and hero capes for Pip and Mela without haggling.
Met Vulpanii tailor Veskara, learned of old stories about many-tailed fox spirits and Elder Shaveth, and left Room 13 contact details so Veskara could ask Shaveth to meet.
Returned to Room 13 after buying household supplies, fruit, snacks, and fur-care products.
Noticed Kestrel was quieter than usual, followed her into the corridor, and kept asking until she admitted fear that the conspiracy may start eliminating witnesses.
Accepted Kestrel's security concerns, agreed that Nyx and Elandria should be included in planning, and reaffirmed that friends do not need to take turns being important.
Shared a three-tap wall check-in with Kestrel as a quiet 'I am okay' signal.

Ended the chapter in Room 13 sharing late-night conversation with Sari about family, community, his lost godlike power, his wives, his origin in another universe, and his preference for small ordinary moments over spectacle.
Allowed Sari to share the bed as a guest while carefully moving Pip and Mela into Pip's drawer-den, then noticed Pip's rapid growth had nearly outpaced the drawer.
